scoring_justification: The final properties are aggregated values from MD simulations; recomputing from raw CSV stress-strain curves would be complex for a lightweight checker, so result-level compare against paper gold with generous tolerances is acceptable and ensures monotonic reward.

outputs.description: Intrinsic thermal conductivity and effective phonon mean free path of phagraphene at 300 K along armchair and zigzag directions.
Elastic modulus and tensile strength of phagraphene at 300 K along armchair and zigzag directions.

output_contract.notes: Thermal conductivity and mechanical properties are extracted from NEMD and tensile MD simulations, respectively. The checker compares the reported values to the paper-reported gold with appropriate tolerances and trend verification (κ_zigzag > κ_armchair, modulus_armchair > modulus_zigzag).

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported gold values for thermal and mechanical properties
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 1 of the paper (10.1039/C6RA05082D): κ_armchair 218±20 W/m-K, κ_zigzag 285±29 W/m-K, Λ_eff armchair 74.9±5.6 nm, zigzag 94.3±6.1 nm; modulus armchair 870±15 GPa, zigzag 800±14 GPa; tensile strength both 85±2 GPa.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's results section and summary table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported values from the original computational study, published in the paper.
